summary: Invoice line for replayed postbacks from retired edge proxies resulting in unexpected charge
description:
Issue summary: Customer FinScale Analytics reports an unexpected invoice charge tied to a single finalized invoice (invoice_2026_02_28) — an invoice line appears to bill ~18,700 embedding tokens that FinScale reports did not originate from production traffic. Impact: Customer is seeing a finalized charge of €3,740.50 on 2026-02-28 and requests reversal/credit; this blocks their finance team from closing the books for the month. Environment: prod, eu-west, hybrid-hosted with Private fallback to FinScale's VPC.

Observed behavior: Postback aggregator shows a burst of backfilled postbacks spanning 2026-02-27 23:45 -> 2026-02-28 00:12 UTC. Many of the postbacks reference API keys tied to FinScale but have edge-proxy metadata headers referencing edge-proxy IDs that were retired in our scheduled decommission on 2026-02-26. The reconciler accepted the late arrivals and attached them to the finalized invoice window, causing net additional billed tokens.

Steps to reproduce / reproduce criteria:
1) Look up invoice invoice_2026_02_28 and identify invoice line id 77891.
2) Cross-reference postback table for tag org_id: finscale-org and timestamps 2026-02-27/28.
3) Filter postbacks where header X-Edge-Proxy-ID matches retired proxies list (decom_2026_02_26_*).
4) Confirm reconciliation created usage_event records with source=postback-reconciler and finalized_flag=true.

Relevant logs / evidence:
- Postback stream IDs: pb-7f4a9c3d..pb-7f4a9d12 (list exported to SRE).
- Reconciler job log: reconciler-run-2026-02-28T01:05Z (attached excerpted grep).
- Edge-proxy decommission PR: github.com/redwood-inference/edge-proxy/pull/88 (executor retired proxies but left drain TTL at 72h in staging config).
- Customer timeline: FinScale support email sent 2026-03-11 09:17 CET with CSV of unexpected invoice lines.

Customer impact notes: Finance escalation; customer requests immediate provisional credit and a postmortem explaining why retired proxies generated replayed postbacks that were billed to production org. They indicate these were test probes from a third-party partner that were supposed to be filtered to staging.

Current status: In Progress — triaged by Billing and SRE. Preliminary hypothesis: decommissioned edge proxies were still emitting probe traffic due to a misconfigured drain TTL; postback-reconciler treated late-arriving postbacks as valid usage because they had production org_id and correct signature, and our postback deduplication window did not catch replays originating from retired proxies.
investigation_notes: 03/12 13:20 CET: Support ingested customer CSV and matched invoice line to reconciler_uids.
03/12 15:05 CET: SRE replayed reconciler logs; identified recon-run job that accepted postbacks with header X-Edge-Proxy-ID decom_2026_02_26_07 and timestamps within the billing window.
03/13 09:45 CET: Billing confirmed postback->usage_event->invoice_line chain; no duplicate detection triggered because message IDs differed due to proxy rewrite.

03/13 11:30 CET: Edge team verified drain TTL was set to 72h in the live deploy branch; decommission step should have used immediate drain for retired proxies but did not due to missing flag in the runbook (PR #88 altered behavior).
03/14 08:00 CET: Reconciler team attached hotfix to ignore postbacks from proxies with 'decom_' prefix and to require original-client-ip header for attribution when proxies are retired (PR pending).
workaround: A provisional credit has been issued to FinScale for the full disputed amount while we complete reconciliation (credit_id: CR-2026-03-14-FS). Temporary mitigation: Block all postbacks that present X-Edge-Proxy-ID matching retired list from being accepted into the reconciler; this is enabled for eu-west staging and will be rolled to prod after smoke tests.
resolution_plan:
Short-term: issue provisional credit and revert charged invoice line; deploy reconciler filter to drop postbacks from retired proxies and re-run reconciliation for invoices impacted (target 2026-03-15).
Long-term: update decommission runbook to set drain TTL=0 for retired proxies, add reconciler validation for proxy provenance, and add a reconciliation audit that flags large single-org inflows from retired proxies older than 12h. Postmortem and customer-facing RCA to be published under support:Postmortems within 10 business days.
time_estimate_to_fix: 48 hours for production filter and invoice correction; 10 business days for RCA and process changes.
comments: Aisha Kapoor (Support) 2026-03-12 13:40: Added initial ticket after receiving customer's CSV. Asked Billing to freeze invoice adjustments until SRE confirms source.

BillingOps (Omar Ruiz) 2026-03-12 14:05: Reconciler chain identified — creating provisional credit hold; not issuing credit until SRE confirms replay source. Linking to SUP-733555 for similar postback phantom cases.

SRE (Liam O'Connor) 2026-03-13 10:12: Found drain TTL mismatch; filed hotfix to reconciler to ignore retired-proxy postbacks. Patch in PR: github.com/redwood-inference/postback-reconciler/pull/412. Will run reconciliation replay after merge.
FinScale (Elena M.) 2026-03-13 16:22: Thanks — we need an immediate provisional credit to avoid payment hold. Our finance lead is cc'd. Awaiting confirmation.
BillingOps (Omar Ruiz) 2026-03-14 09:30: Issued provisional credit CR-2026-03-14-FS for €3,740.50 and marked invoice as disputed in accounting system. Pending reconciler replay and final adjustment.
resolution: Provisional credit issued on 2026-03-14 and reconciler filter deployed to prod (eu-west) on 2026-03-14 11:10 UTC. Reconciliation replay scheduled and invoice correction planned for 2026-03-15. Final RCA to be posted once runbook and reconciler changes are merged and validated.
notes_for_finance: Customer requested credit reversal and invoice correction. Provisional credit CR-2026-03-14-FS applied; please hold collection and do not escalate to collections. Once replay completes, issue corrected invoice or credit memo referencing original invoice_2026_02_28. Attach reconciler job id recon-replay-2026-03-15-01 to correction.
follow_up_actions: Deploy reconciler patch to drop retired-proxy postbacks — done (2026-03-14).
Replay reconciliation for date range 2026-02-27..2026-02-28 and regenerate invoice lines for finscale-org (scheduled 2026-03-15).
Update edge-proxy decommission runbook to set drain TTL=0 and add a pre-decom validation step (owner: Edge team; due 2026-03-19).
Publish customer-facing RCA and internal postmortem (owner: Support/SRE; due 2026-03-26).
